publication_verification: Caller must independently verify this remote commit exists before invoking register; this CLI argument is not independent publication evidence

protocol.purpose: Current independent-process numerical repeatability of a fixed diagnostic subpanel
protocol.chronology: Post-original and post-full-replay diagnostic; publish protocol and runner before these new fits
protocol.claim_limit: Six diagnostic cells only; neither full R465 repeatability nor exact original recovery

panel.reason: top three absolute epoch changes; ties model then seed
top three absolute epoch changes; ties model then seed
top three absolute epoch changes; ties model then seed

protocol.panel_rule: GRU/LSTM/TCN at first registered seed8101 plus three greatest absolute historical→replay selected-epoch changes; ties by model then seed. Chosen after old replay, before any new repeatability fits; all results retained.
protocol.replicate_processes: Separate CLI invocations, fresh pools, independent empty private directories; run a then b
protocol.job_order: Published panel list in order; each job resets Python/NumPy/Torch seeds and independent shuffle generator

failure_policy.technical_failures: Stop and preserve original error/artifacts; no replacement of unfavorable seeds; resume only exact registered jobs after root-cause review
failure_policy.missing_reserve_dates: Abort primary analysis rather than silently changing the cohort
failure_policy.degenerate_pilot: Report inability to plan if paired variance cannot be estimated; never substitute an arbitrary successful power
failure_policy.infeasible_sample_size: Report required R and infeasibility; never silently cap R or claim target power
failure_policy.protocol_changes: Any scientific change after results starts a new version; never overwrite frozen protocol

settings.selection: Mean across two seeds of RMSE pooled over all January-October validation dates; not mean monthly RMSE

protocol.primary_acceptance: All six cells have identical selected_epoch, e1-csv-values-v1 hashes of both histories, e1-state-dict-v1 tensor hashes and checkpoint metadata hashes between a and b. Exact equality; no fitted tolerance.

secondary_numerical_equivalence.elementwise_rule: abs(a-b) <= atol + rtol*max(abs(a),abs(b)); symmetric and fixed before new fits
secondary_numerical_equivalence.values: Every numeric loss/LR CSV cell and every tensor element; no observations or predictions
secondary_numerical_equivalence.structure_rule: Equal selected_epoch, curve row counts, epoch/stage/best_epoch, missingness, tensor names/dtypes/shapes and checkpoint metadata; otherwise no whole-fit equivalence
secondary_numerical_equivalence.interpretation: Separate secondary numerical classification, never relabel a strict canonical failure as an exact pass

protocol.secondary_comparisons: Report all a/b vs existing full replay raw/canonical hashes and historical raw hashes, without optimizing settings to improve agreement
protocol.failure_policy: Stop, retain every partial output; no seed substitution, tuning, retry, cache reuse or extension of scope. Any further fits require a new published protocol.
